from pathlib import Path
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    points={(v,r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v in (1,2)}
    (_,r1,c1),(_,r2,c2)=sorted(points)
    sr=1 if r2>r1 else -1 if r2<r1 else 0
    sc=1 if c2>c1 else -1 if c2<c1 else 0
    r,c=r1,c1
    # Trace diagonal first, then the remaining axis, stopping adjacent to marker 2.
    while r != r2-sr and c != c2-sc:
        r+=sr; c+=sc
        if (r,c)!=(r2,c2): out[r][c]=3
    while r != r2-sr:
        r+=sr
        if (r,c)!=(r2,c2): out[r][c]=3
    while c != c2-sc:
        c+=sc
        if (r,c)!=(r2,c2): out[r][c]=3
    return out
'''
